description.narrative: Among other things to support the Ukranian authority SNRIU in dealing with ageing in nuclear power plants, non-destructive testing (NDT) of components, regulations for licensing of nuclear fuel, as well as establishing software for risk evaluation.

Att bl.a. stödja myndigheten i Ukraina att hantera åldring i kärnkraftverk, oförstörande provning (OFP) av komponenter, föreskrifter för licensiering av kärnbränsle, samt etablering av mjukvara för riskbedömningar.
Cooperation on reactor safety and non-proliferation within the radiation protection and emergency preparedness areas, as well as dealing with radioactive waste.
Samarbete inom reaktorsäkerhets- och icke spridningsområdet, inom strålskydds- och beredskapsområdet, samt hantering av radioaktivt avfall.

The Ukrainian authority SNRIU now has better knowledge of dealing with ageing in nuclear power plants, non-destructive testing (NDT) of components, regulations for licensing of nuclear fuel, as well as establishing software for risk evaluation.
